evals.prompt: New baby at home, sleep is chaos, I have maybe 3 x 40 min a week. I just don't want to lose what I've built over the last 3 years.
evals.expected_output: Frames maintenance as a real phase, prescribes 6–10 hard sets/muscle at high intensity across 3 short full-body sessions, keeps some cardio, and sets maintenance calories.

evals.prompt: Between meets, what's the least I can do and hold my strength?
evals.expected_output: Gives the minimum-effective-dose strength template (1–2 sessions per lift, 2–3 sets at RPE 7–9) and explains why intensity is the lever that can't drop.
